t: You keep speaking to me as though nothing stands between us.
I have not forgotten, even if that would suit you.
There you are, acting innocent again.
Do you truly expect me to greet you warmly?
I see you have found another reason to avoid me.
We have left this unspoken for too long.
{god} asks honesty of us, so I will not pretend all is well.
I have prayed for patience with you. It has not come.
Maybe I should let this go. I still cannot.
I keep waiting for this bitterness to mean something. It does not.
No god will settle what stands between you and me.
Do not hide behind the shrine when I am speaking to you.
You have been glaring at me again. What is it this time?
If you have something to say, stop making me guess.
I know you dislike me. I still do not know why.
Must every meeting begin with that look?
You have judged me already, so why start another argument?
Whatever you think I owe you, name it plainly.
{god} knows my faults. I wish you would name the one you mean.
I have prayed that we might speak without anger. Shall we try?
Maybe I deserve your anger. How would I know when you say nothing?
I once thought faith might mend this. Now I am less certain.
Leave {god} out of your dislike and speak for yourself.
A shrine cannot tell me why you keep looking at me like that.
You know enough. You simply prefer saying you do not.
I tried speaking plainly before. You heard only what suited you.
Do not make my anger the whole problem between us.
You want an easy answer so you can dismiss it.
I am speaking now. Listen instead of defending yourself.
Your confusion does not make my feeling disappear.
{god} knows what happened, even if you deny understanding it.
I asked {god} to help me forgive you. I am still waiting.
Perhaps I remember it wrongly. That does not make the hurt smaller.
I do not know what faith expects here. I know I am still angry.
This is between us. Stop waiting for heaven to explain me.
I need an answer from you, not another visit to the shrine.
Then tell me what you believe I have ignored.
I cannot answer a charge you refuse to explain.
I am listening, but anger is not an explanation.
You may have reason. That does not mean I can read your mind.
I will answer for what I did, once I understand what you mean.
If I dismissed you before, I am not doing so now.
Let {god} witness this conversation. I am willing to hear you.
If I wronged you, {god} expects me to face it.
Perhaps faith asks too much of both of us. Speak anyway.
I am uncertain about heaven, not about hearing your complaint.
Good. Then leave heaven out and tell me what I did.
The shrine has no part in this. I am standing here.
You always ask for details after the moment has passed.
Now you listen because my silence became inconvenient.
I should not have to prove every reason I distrust you.
You keep asking what happened instead of asking what might mend it.
I hear your words. I do not yet believe them.
One honest answer would help more than all this confusion.
{god} may know your heart. I only know how you treat me.
Forgiveness is not pretending nothing happened. {god} must know that.
Maybe this anger has lasted too long. I cannot end it alone.
I want to believe speaking helps. Give me a reason.
No divine sign is coming. Either answer me or do not.
We made this bitterness ourselves. We can face it ourselves.
I cannot mend something while you keep its shape hidden.
I am trying to understand. Stop treating that as another offence.
Distrust me if you must, but give me something I can answer.
You say I never listen, then refuse to speak clearly.
I may have failed you. I will not confess to a mystery.
Tell me what would help, and I will decide what I can do.
{god} asks repentance, but first I must know my wrong.
I will pray about my part after you tell me what it was.
Maybe belief cannot mend this. Plain speech might still help.
I do not know what {god} wants. I know this cannot continue.
No higher power owes us an answer. We owe each other one.
Forget the shrine. Say what would actually settle this.
I have said enough. Do what you will with it.
We are not settled, but I am finished speaking today.
Leave me alone until you have an honest answer.
I cannot keep arguing with someone who claims not to understand.
That is all you are getting from me for now.
Perhaps we can speak again when neither of us is shouting.
{god} heard us both. I will leave judgment there for now.
I will pray before we speak again. This anger is doing no good.
Maybe time will change this. Faith has not done so yet.
I do not know whether forgiveness is coming. I need distance now.
Heaven has nothing to add. Stay away from me for now.
No prayer will finish this conversation. I am leaving.
I cannot answer what you will not name. We are done for today.
Come back when you want an answer more than another argument.
I have listened. I will think about what little you told me.
We should stop before this becomes worse than it already is.
I will not beg for forgiveness without knowing the charge.
Take your distance. I will be here when you speak plainly.
{god} knows whether I wronged you. I will ask for wisdom.
I will pray for truth between us before we try again.
Maybe {god} can help later. Right now, we should part.
I am unsure what faith offers us. Silence will do for now.
The shrine will not settle this, and neither will more shouting.
We do not need heaven to stop this argument. Goodbye.
